address: 460 Hackney Road, Hackney, London, E2 9EG, United Kingdom
bio: After a succession of pop-ups, friends Zac and Freddie found a permanent home at this rustic restaurant where bright prints enliven exposed concrete walls and the mix-and-match wooden tables fit the informal vibe. The overtly seasonal menu changes daily, but you can expect interesting and full-flavoured dishes such as grilled Bobby beans with piperade, smoked almonds and cherries, in which the flavours and textures all work together beautifully. In a fun twist on the traditional, they serve a roast dinner on Mondays. The genial service team run things well....
